messages.text:
"A game based on the plot of a \"helluva boss\" where the main character is Stolas, who will have to choose between two guys, namely Blitzo or Vassago, with whom he will continue to live his life after he reconciled with his daughter Octavia. You need to make the right choice to find happiness for Stolas and his daughter. The game's story is quite long, as it will feature two routes, each with a good and a bad ending.
"
